decision.rationale: Numerical comparison before consuming 2 remaining physical experiments: sensor_lag fit on action-2, action-6, initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 gives training RMSE 0.0786C BIC -3007, but training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy and is provisional only. Linear not yet compared on expanded action-6-inclusive evidence; fit linearly on same evidence. Prior probes action-2 RMSE 0.0819C and action-6 RMSE 0.0748C are no-mismatch on those inputs only.
